jp: 今日は＜グーテンベルグ＞の
配布があるのか・・・
en: So today is the Gutenberg handout...

jp: 閑散としているはずだ
en: No wonder the town is so deserted.

jp: プロデヴォン教団の教えと
人々が守るべき規律が記された
en: A book of the Prodevon Church's teachings and the rules the people must keep.
Its formal name is the Gutenberg Book of Precepts.

jp: 呼ばれているが、カインも島に
居た時にはもらっていたはずだ
en: Most people just call it the Book. You should have received one on the island, too.

jp: そういえば、そんな名前の本が
ウチにもあったかもしれない・・
en: Now that you mention it, we might have had a book like that at home..
Every resident is required to own one.

jp: この機を逃すべきではない
en: ...Yes. We should not let this chance slip by.

jp: ＜グーテンベルグ＞を受け取りに
教会には多くの住民達が集まる
en: Many residents will gather at the church to receive the Gutenberg.

jp: その対応に追われているはずだ
en: The Church's people will have their hands full dealing with them.

jp: これは教団の人間に接触して
en: A perfect chance to approach someone from the Church and draw out information.

jp: ええと、ヨハネが言いたいのは
教会に行こうってことだよね？
en: Um, so what you're saying, Johannes, is that we should go to the church too, right?
Yes. That is what I mean.
